Key points
• Phenylketonuria was the ﬁrst inherited metabolic disorder to be identiﬁed by newborn screening and managed by nutrition
to prevent adverse intellectual outcomes.
• A phenylalanine-restricted diet requires the use of medical food to provide protein without phenylalanine; the semi-
synthetic nature of the diet and restriction of whole protein result in increased risk for inadequate growth, reduced bone
mineral density, as well as essential fatty acid and vitamin and mineral deﬁciencies.
